tasks.title: Text → stereo image
tasks.description: Stereo photographs generated from a text description.

samples.context: A golden retriever sitting in the center of a sunlit park path, facing the camera, the tree-lined path receding into soft haze behind it.
A border collie standing in the center of a wooden jetty, the planks and mooring posts receding to a calm mountain lake behind it.
An old man with a white beard sitting on a chair in the center of a long library aisle, bookshelves receding into shadow behind him.
A toddler in a yellow raincoat standing in the center of a garden path, flower beds and a greenhouse receding behind.
A brown bear standing in the center of a shallow river, forested banks receding upstream behind it.
A young woman in a red raincoat standing in the center of a wet city street, facing the camera, neon signs and traffic lights receding into the drizzle behind her.
A great horned owl perched on a fence post in the center of the frame, golden grassland stretching away to a treeline far behind it.
A black labrador puppy sitting in the center of a kitchen floor, cabinets and a sunlit doorway receding behind it.
A bearded blacksmith standing in the center of his workshop beside an anvil, racks of tools and a glowing forge receding into the dark behind him.
A red panda sitting on a thick branch in the center of the frame, layered green canopy falling away behind it.

tasks.title: Text → stereo video
tasks.description: Stereo video clips generated from a text description.

samples.context: A golden retriever sitting in the center of a gravel garden path, panting happily with its tail wagging, rose bushes lining the path as it recedes to a wooden gate far behind. Static camera.
A snowy owl standing in the center of a frozen lake shore, turning its head, bare trees and a pale horizon far behind it. Static camera.
A street musician playing a violin in the center of an empty plaza, bow moving steadily, arcades and a fountain receding behind him. Static camera.
A toddler in a yellow raincoat standing in the center of a garden path, reaching toward the camera, flower beds and a greenhouse receding behind. Static camera.
A brown bear standing in the center of a shallow river, water running around its legs, forested banks receding upstream behind it. Static camera.
A tabby cat sitting upright in the center of a narrow cobblestone alley, tail curling slowly, laundry lines and lanterns receding into the dusk behind it. Static camera.
A brown horse standing in the center of a misty paddock facing the camera, mane stirring in the wind, a wooden fence line receding toward hills on the horizon. Static camera.
A scarlet macaw perched on a mossy branch in the center of the frame, ruffling its feathers, layered jungle foliage falling away into deep green shadow behind it. Static camera.
A german shepherd sitting in the center of a forest clearing, ears twitching, tall pines receding into green shadow behind it. Static camera.
A red panda sitting on a thick branch in the center of the frame, chewing bamboo, layered green canopy falling away behind it. Static camera.
